description: Correction factors applied to library/tables/ampacity.json single-conductor base ratings: ambient temperature (per insulation temperature rating column) and conductor-count bunching. Same source and scope notes as ampacity.json.
source: Remington Industries 'Copper Hook-Up Wire Ampacity by Insulation Temperature Rating' (Revision 0): 'Correction Factors by Ambient Temperature' and 'Correction Factors by Number of Conductors' tables.

ambient_temperature_correction.description: Keyed by insulation temperature rating column, then by ambient range 'lo-hi' (inclusive, C). A segment's containing bundle computed.max_ambient_c selects the bucket; below the lowest bucket (<=30C, the table's own reference ambient) the factor is 1.0 -- we do not extrapolate a >1.0 bonus for cooler-than-reference ambients.

conductor_count_correction.description: Keyed by 'lo-hi' (inclusive) count of current-carrying conductors bunched together (bundle computed.conductor_count). 1-3 conductors: no correction (the single-conductor table already represents a lightly-bunched free-air run). A segment not in any bundle is treated as count=1.
